scripts.bootstrap:admin: pnpm --filter @weave/backend build && pnpm --filter @weave/backend exec dotenv -e ../../.env -- node dist/bootstrap-admin.js
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @weave/types build && pnpm --filter @weave/utils build && pnpm -r --parallel --filter './app/*' run dev
scripts.dev:backend: pnpm --filter @weave/types build && pnpm --filter @weave/utils build && pnpm --filter @weave/backend dev
scripts.dev:frontend: pnpm --filter @weave/types build && pnpm --filter @weave/utils build && pnpm --filter @weave/frontend dev
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @weave/types build && pnpm --filter @weave/utils build && pnpm -r --if-present run test
